title: إشعار السوق
starting_condition: Complete Mission 001, then speak to Nora Blake again near the Marsa Al-Noor lighthouse.

stages.objective: Speak to Nora after Mission 001 to start the next chapter.
Inspect the Harbor Market shipping noticeboard.
Return to Nora near the lighthouse and report what the notice says.
Receive the $300 reward and continue exploring.

notes: This is a provisional original story proposal and not a final approved chapter outline.
Mission progression, objective tracking, prerequisite state, reward settlement, GPS target selection and local save restoration are implemented for this first playable pass.
Dialogue is currently text-only. No Arabic voice performance is claimed.
